entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Charlie, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse you people sold me. It's a complete piece of junk and I'm furious I wasted my money on it.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A preference? Are you kidding me? The thing is broken! It's completely defective. It's not working, it won't sync with my phone, nothing! I've had it for a couple of weeks and it's useless. I want my money back now or I'm putting a review on every website I can find.
Okay, I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the trouble you're having. Let me just pull up your account with your phone number... one moment.
You'd better. Don't try to give me the runaround and transfer me to someone else. I want a refund, not a tech lesson.
I understand completely. Okay, I see your order here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered 18 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Yeah, you do that. This is ridiculous.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that since the device is defective, and you received it just 18 days ago, you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh. Okay, good. That's what I wanted to hear. So what do I do?

I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account right now. Just package the item back in its original box, apply the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Finally, some decent service. Alright, thank you, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Again, I apologize for the inconvenience with the defective band. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just get me that label.
It's already been sent. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
